market.ground: Restricted to the 5 endpoints with >=50 test rows in the nn_sim<0.3 bin (melting_point 215, logkow 128, water_solubility 122, boiling_point 86, vapor_pressure 85) after CRITIC's power challenge; all others reported as underpowered with n. Conditions: dimension-matched or capacity control, stratify by rotatable-bond count, READER-1's mechanism prior that single-molecule gas-phase physics has no mechanism for melting point.
market.reversal: Compute scope later widened to full coverage on GPU (team notes N-007/N-009) while the claim stayed restricted.

market.title_short: Rebuilt spectral representation beats the old one
market.ground: CPU only; feeds the spectrum-only deliverable; a negative is publishable. Conditions: precursor-mass-only and mass+ion-type controls (CRITIC), identical compound set and hyperparameters, dimension-matched, representation reviewed before fitting, naive baseline = the subset's own train mean (READER-1), no *_present/count features, adduct labels checked on the label side only.

Rejected as a CLAIM on power and capacity: the only clean design is CRITIC's 2x2 crossover, and it would be scored on kOH (101 test rows, 30 leak-free) and pka_acidic (172 / 38). OPS-2 had finished its budget and the agents who could own it were carrying deliverables.
market.reversal: PARTIALLY REVERSED for compute only (T-036): GPU credit expires tomorrow and team note N-009 forbids reporting a GPU calculation as incomplete for lack of compute. The descriptors are computed and shipped as a dataset; the modelling claim stays unfunded.

market.title_short: Measured receptor potencies beat model-derived hazard labels
market.ground: Funded without docking. CRITIC's circularity challenge accepted: evaluation reported on BOTH held-out measured ChEMBL potency AND the CompTox receptor labels, the latter being OPERA consensus calls rather than measurements. Rare positives reported as PR-AUC against each bin's own base rate with a familiarity-only control; accuracy never reported as skill.
market.reversal: Docking was later attempted anyway on team-note instruction and failed on credentials (nvcr.io pull access denied), recorded as a limitation, not as a result.

market.title_short: Input modes form a user matrix
market.ground: Skill bar pre-registered before running: RMSE <=85% of that mode's own naive baseline with a cluster-bootstrap CI excluding 100%. Structure arms from W-MODEL v5 on one agreed compound list.
market.reversal: NMR arm first cut, then REINSTATED: the 113-compound figure was an artefact of labels_v2's has_nmr flag; NMRexp joins to 8,679 of 27,730 labelled compounds. Assigned to W-TP.

market.decision: REJECTED then REVERSED to a DELIVERABLE
market.ground: Rejected as framed: the novelty half ('no public dataset exists') is uncheckable from this VM (PubChem/EPI-only network) and probably false, and I judged the artefact to be a bet competing with the deliverables.
market.reversal: REVERSED after team note N-005: it is a stakeholder deliverable ranking with the dashboard and whitepaper, not a bet. Novelty framing dropped; target raised to all 782,693 inventory structures after N-007.

market.ground: Premise false for the model (W-TP: first-generation hydrolysis products median nn_sim_train 0.489 vs parents 0.455, n=202) and the stated test cannot fail (interval width widens by construction for a Mondrian-by-nn-bin conformal model).

market.title_short: TPs test extrapolation only where the TP is measured
market.ground: Funded on W-TP's own pair counts (logkow 271, MP 508, VP 137, WS 130, BP 90 measured non-train parent->product pairs). Conditions: cluster bootstrap, pathway breakdown, delta sign AND magnitude vs EPI, empirical coverage beside nominal, and an explicit statement that it tests the property change and not whether the transformation occurs.

market.title_short: Graph-CV has the power to settle 'does physics help far from training'
market.ground: The only design with power to tell a null from no-power: leak-free n rises from 3-813 to 250-19,500 with verified max test-to-train similarity 0.398. Conditions: identical compound set across arms, q_total_e dropped, paired within fold, naive = fold-train mean, stated resampling unit, W-PHYSICS sign-off, and a well-powered NULL counts as success.
